beats.what: The crossing point has shifted south, from north Andhra–south Odisha to between Machilipatnam and Visakhapatnam, on the evening of Oct 27. Telangana feels it on Oct 28, mainly in the east and northeast.
beats.why: It's still developing; IMD says its track and strength will be clearer once it becomes a depression. For drought-hit Telangana, the rain is also a ray of hope.
beats.care: In Warangal, Hanumakonda, Khammam or Kothagudem? Plan around Oct 28. Hyderabad: carry an umbrella on Oct 28.

cards.body: Red alert (heavy to very heavy, isolated extremely heavy): Mulugu, Bhadradri Kothagudem, Khammam. Orange: Jayashankar Bhupalpally, Mahabubabad, Warangal, Hanumakonda, Suryapet. Yellow: Mancherial, Rajanna Sircilla, Karimnagar, Peddapalli, Jangaon, Nalgonda, Siddipet, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri. Thunderstorms and gusty winds likely.

cards.title: why the name 'Arnab' isn't official yet
cards.body: A storm gets the next name on the list (Arnab) only if it becomes a cyclonic storm. IMD is still calling this a developing system; its strength will be clearer once it becomes a depression.
The landfall forecast moved south since Friday. That's why east Telangana, not Odisha, now gets the heaviest rain.

cards.q: Cyclone week. Are you changing any plans?

cards.why: 3 red, 5 orange and 8 yellow (IMD via The Hindu, Oct 25).

learn.t: Cyclone names come from a list made by 13 countries around the Indian Ocean and are used in order. A storm is named only when its winds reach cyclonic strength (63 km/h or more).
